spec_name: LONG-002B-AMEND-001: Blocked data-family resolution (security identity/lifecycle/exclusions and earnings-event timing)
purpose: Determine, with bounded and auditable provider probes, whether a defensible point-in-time pathway exists for the two LONG-002B blockers: (1) security identity, lifecycle, and exclusion classification; and (2) historical known-at-the-decision-time earnings scheduling. This amendment does not authorize LONG-002C dataset construction.

security_identity_lifecycle_and_exclusio.role: Point-in-time security identity, effective-dated ticker/listing history, active/inactive/renamed/merged/delisted securities, exchange and listing provenance, and defensible classification for the locked LONG-002 exclusions

preferred_provider.name: massive
required_capabilities: single-ticker PIT details with list_date, delisted_utc, active, primary_exchange, type, cik, composite_figi, share_class_figi
ticker type taxonomy with asset_class and description
split and dividend event metadata with ex/pay/record dates

fallback_order.name: alpaca
fallback_order.caution: Alpaca asset class does not distinguish ETFs/ETNs/CEFs/pre-merger SPACs.

fallback_order.name: sec_edgar
fallback_order.restriction: EDGAR submissions do not provide a complete exchange security master or security-type classification.

security_identity_lifecycle_and_exclusio.stop_condition: Stop provider exploration once the probe panel demonstrates stable PIT identity, lifecycle evidence (active/inactive/delisted/renamed), defensible exclusion-type classification, and split/dividend provenance.

earnings_event_timing.role: Historical known-at-the-decision-time earnings scheduling: future earnings dates known at the decision timestamp, subsequent revisions, actual release timestamps, and separation from SEC filing/disclosure timestamps and current/prospective calendars

preferred_provider.name: massive
required_capabilities: historical earnings announcement or report dates
vintage information distinguishing when a future date was known
separation of schedule from actual SEC filing acceptance

fallback_order.name: sec_edgar
fallback_order.restriction: Actual disclosure timing only; cannot substitute for a previously known future schedule.

fallback_order.name: yahoo_earnings_calendar
fallback_order.restriction: Current/prospective operational diagnostics only; cannot substitute historical knowledge.

earnings_event_timing.stop_condition: Stop once at least one source demonstrates historical known-at-time earnings scheduling for the probe panel, or all preregistered candidates fail and an explicit 'unknown' treatment is recorded.

locked_panel.category: recent IPO cohort; later renamed META (holdout)
excluded preferred stock ETF; excluded type diagnostic
excluded closed-end fund; excluded type diagnostic

explicit_prohibitions: No full LONG-002 historical dataset construction
No outcome census or target-label calculation
No forward-return, MFE, MAE, clean-target, or adverse-rate calculation
No model fitting or configuration search
No validation/holdout return or outcome access
No production signal, score, weight, threshold, ranking, eligibility, or default screener changes
No brokerage or account data access
No new provider beyond the preregistered candidates without a separate Gary-approved amendment
